units.summary: Lumivaara is a family-owned third-party logistics company founded in 2009.
units.quote: Third-party logistics (3PL) company founded in 2009 by the Lindholm family.

units.summary: The company provides contract warehousing, domestic road freight, e-commerce fulfilment, customs clearance and value-added logistics services.
units.quote: The company provides contract warehousing, domestic road freight, e-commerce fulfilment, customs clearance and value-added logistics services to business customers across Finland.

units.summary: The company operates warehouses in Vantaa, Tampere and Oulu; Vantaa is the main site and head office.
units.quote: Three warehouses: Vantaa (main site and head office), Tampere and Oulu.

units.summary: The three warehouses have a combined area of 33,500 m².
units.quote: Operations are run from three warehouses in Vantaa, Tampere and Oulu with a combined warehouse area of 33,500 m².

units.summary: The company employed 134 people measured as full-time equivalents, with temporary agency staff during peak seasons.
units.quote: The company employs 134 people (full-time equivalents at the end of 2025), complemented by temporary agency staff during peak seasons.

units.summary: The company’s revenue was EUR 24.6 million.
The company has approximately 210 active business customers.
units.quote: The company has approximately 210 active business customers.

units.summary: The company’s largest customer segments include retail and e-commerce, industrial spare parts, chilled food and beverage, and a growing pharma and healthcare segment.
units.quote: Largest segments: retail and e-commerce, industrial spare parts, chilled food and beverage, and a small but growing pharma/healthcare segment (GDP-certified area in Vantaa since 2024).

units.summary: The company described its margins as getting thinner amid fuel costs, wage settlements and price pressure from large customers.
units.quote: Kaisa described margins as "thin and getting thinner" - fuel, wage settlements and price pressure from large customers.

units.summary: The company wants to grow without hiring more office staff for each new customer.
units.quote: We want to grow, but we cannot keep hiring more office people for every new customer.

units.summary: Several of the company’s large retail contracts are due for renewal.
units.quote: Several of the big retail contracts come up for renewal in 2027.

units.summary: The company’s strategy sets a target to reduce manual work in office processes by 30%.
units.quote: Operational excellence – reduce manual work in office processes by 30 % by the end of 2028 so that growth does not require additional office staff.

units.summary: The company’s strategy aims to grow revenue to EUR 30 million, particularly in pharma/healthcare and industrial spare parts, while improving the EBIT margin to 5%.
units.quote: Profitable growth – grow revenue to EUR 30 million by 2028, especially in pharma/healthcare and industrial spare parts, while improving the EBIT margin to 5 %.
